collection_name: Telugu news websites and e-papers (Eenadu, Sakshi, Andhra Jyothy, Namasthe Telangana, Prajasakti, Nava Telangana, Mana Telangana, Vaartha, BBC Telugu, Oneindia Telugu, Samayam)
description: The dominant source of contemporary Telugu text on the web; underlies most web-crawl corpora (IndicCorp, Sangraha, CC-derived sets) and news datasets (XL-Sum = BBC Telugu).
api_endpoint: RSS feeds and sitemaps per site
acquisition_method: Content licensing with publishers, or rely on existing research crawls (with their licence limits). Respect robots.txt.
verification_method: Sites reachable (HTTP 200); prajasakti.com timed out; terms not read individually
processing_needs: Licensing; boilerplate removal; dedup with crawls.

description: Small Wikimedia projects — Telugu Wikiquote (884 content pages; proverbs, quotations) and Telugu Wikibooks (287 content pages).
size_telugu: Wikiquote 884 content / 4,953 total pages; Wikibooks 287 content / 2,564 total pages
acquisition_method: dumps.wikimedia.org/tewikiquote and /tewikibooks
verification_method: siteinfo statistics API

description: Full-text dumps of Telugu Wikipedia (articles, talk, templates; also SQL link tables and Cirrus JSON). Site statistics on 2026-11-09 report 130,627 content articles and 432,091 pages in total.
genres: encyclopedic; biography; geography; cinema; history; science
metadata_fields: page id; title; revision id; timestamp; contributor; categories
annotations: wiki markup; categories; interlanguage links; Wikidata QIDs
acquisition_method: wget https://dumps.wikimedia.org/tewiki/latest/tewiki-latest-pages-articles.xml.bz2 ; extract with WikiExtractor or mwparserfromhell. Twice-monthly dumps.
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (text; also GFDL for older revisions); media files carry individual licenses
copyright_notes: Share-alike and attribution required; images/media are licensed per file on Commons and are not covered by the text license.
provenance: Volunteer-written; a large share of Telugu Wikipedia consists of bot-generated village/geography stubs (2000s-2010s), which inflates article counts.
verification_method: MediaWiki siteinfo API (statistics, rightsinfo) + dump directory listing
processing_needs: Wiki-markup stripping; filter bot-generated stubs (village articles); dedup against web crawls that already include Wikipedia.

description: Pre-cleaned (markup-stripped) Telugu Wikipedia snapshot from 2023-11-01 in Parquet, one row per article.
acquisition_method: datasets.load_dataset('wikimedia/wikipedia', '20231101.te')
verification_method: HF API + datasets-server size endpoint
processing_needs: Older than live dumps (2023-11); article count lower than current site; same content as TEL-TXT-001.
notes: Article count (87,854) is lower than live site count (130,627) because of snapshot date and filtering of redirects/disambiguation.

description: Large monolingual Telugu corpus crawled from news sites, magazines and books (2020), sentence-split and deduplicated; used to train IndicBERT v1 / IndicFT.
acquisition_method: Historically: wget https://objectstore.e2enetworks.net/ai4b-public-nlu-nlg/v1-indiccorp/te.txt (403 as of 2026-11-09). Use IndicCorp v2 (TEL-TXT-004) instead.
copyright_notes: Underlying news text is copyrighted by publishers; release license covers the compilation.
verification_method: GitHub README table and license section read; download URL returned HTTP 403 in automated check (2026-11-09)
unresolved_issues: Direct download (objectstore te.txt) returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-09 — file may have moved; README column for 3.98M is unlabeled; superseded by IndicCorp v2.
processing_needs: Superseded by v2 (TEL-TXT-004); dedup against v2 if both used.

description: Second-generation IndicCorp (2022), news/web crawl for 23 Indic languages; the Telugu file is a single plain-text file of sentences. Used to train IndicBERT v2.
acquisition_method: huggingface-cli download ai4bharat/IndicCorpV2 data/te.txt --repo-type dataset ; or load_dataset('ai4bharat/IndicCorpV2', 'indiccorp_v2', data_dir='data/tel_Telu')
license: No license tag on HF card; IndicCorp v2 release terms not stated on card
copyright_notes: Crawled publisher content; treat as research-only until license is confirmed.
verification_method: HF tree API (file size), dataset card read
unresolved_issues: License not declared on HF card; check IndicBERT v2 paper / AI4Bharat site for the release license.
processing_needs: Sentence-level; document boundaries lost. Dedup with Sangraha (which builds on IndicCorp sources).

description: Pretraining corpus from the IndicLLMSuite (2024). Three Telugu parts: 'verified' (web + PDF/OCR + speech transcripts, human-checked sources), 'unverified' (filtered web crawl), and 'synthetic' (English Wikipedia machine-translated into Telugu, in Telugu script and romanised).
genres: web; news; books (PDF OCR); speech transcripts; translated Wikipedia
size_telugu: verified/tel 15.10 GB (41 files); unverified/tel 2.36 GB (6 files); synthetic/tel_Telu 18.12 GB (64 files); synthetic/tel_Latn 11.99 GB (64 files)
ocr_transcription: Verified split includes OCR of PDFs and ASR transcripts of videos.
acquisition_method: load_dataset('ai4bharat/sangraha', data_dir='verified/tel') ; repeat for unverified/tel, synthetic/tel_Telu
copyright_notes: CC BY 4.0 covers the compilation; underlying crawled web/PDF content retains original copyright — downstream commercial use carries residual risk.
verification_method: HF API license tag; HF tree API file sizes per folder
processing_needs: Keep synthetic (machine-translated) data separate from natural text; dedup verified vs IndicCorp/CulturaX.

description: Cleaned and deduplicated merge of mC4 and OSCAR for 167 languages (2023); Telugu folder present.
size_telugu: Unknown (gated; per-language token counts are in the CulturaX paper's appendix table)
size_total: 167 languages (dataset documentation); token totals not re-checked
acquisition_method: Accept terms on HF, then load_dataset('uonlp/CulturaX', 'te', token=True)
license: Inherits mC4 (ODC-BY) and OSCAR (CC0 packaging) terms; no HF license tag
copyright_notes: Web text; copyright of underlying pages not cleared.
verification_method: HF API (gated flag, configs list includes 'te')
unresolved_issues: Telugu document/token count not measured (gated). Need HF login to check.
processing_needs: Overlaps mC4/OSCAR completely — use instead of, not in addition to, those.

organization: HPLT consortium (EU Horizon; Univ. Oslo, Helsinki, Edinburgh, Charles Univ., et al.)
description: Web documents from Internet Archive + Common Crawl crawls, language-identified, deduplicated and cleaned (HPLT v2, 2025).
metadata_fields: url; timestamp; lang scores; web register labels; doc quality scores
acquisition_method: load_dataset('HPLT/HPLT2.0_cleaned', 'tel_Telu') or download JSONL from https://hplt-project.org/datasets/v2.0
license: CC0 1.0 (packaging); HPLT also states it does not own the underlying web content
copyright_notes: CC0 applies to the packaging only; takedown procedure exists for rightsholders.
verification_method: HF API + datasets-server size per config
processing_needs: Cross-corpus dedup against FineWeb-2, CulturaX, MADLAD.

description: Common Crawl-derived multilingual pretraining corpus with per-language filtering and dedup (2024-25). Includes Telugu-script and a small romanised Telugu subset.
size_telugu: tel_Telu 1,983,328 docs / 3.99 GB; tel_Latn 24,353 docs / 47 MB
metadata_fields: id; dump; url; date; language_score; minhash cluster size
acquisition_method: load_dataset('HuggingFaceFW/fineweb-2', name='tel_Telu', split='train')
license: ODC-By 1.0 (subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use)
verification_method: HF API + datasets-server size
processing_needs: Dedup against other CC-derived corpora.

description: Common Crawl corpus built with GlotLID language identification for 1,000+ languages (2024); also lists tiny 'wsg-Telu' (Adilabad Gondi in Telugu script) and 'tel-Latn' configs.
acquisition_method: load_dataset('cis-lmu/GlotCC-V1', 'tel-Telu')
verification_method: HF API + datasets-server size
processing_needs: Small relative to FineWeb-2/HPLT; useful mainly for the tiny Telugu-script minority-language configs.

organization: Facebook AI (Conneau et al. 2020), hosted by statmt.org
description: Monolingual Common Crawl data (Jan-Dec 2018 snapshots) used to train XLM-R; paragraphs separated by blank lines.
acquisition_method: wget https://data.statmt.org/cc-100/te.txt.xz
license: No IP claimed by the authors; use subject to Common Crawl Terms of Use
verification_method: HTTP HEAD (Content-Length) on download file
processing_needs: 2018-era crawl; dedup against newer CC corpora.

description: Document-level Common Crawl derived corpus with quality annotations; Telugu subset present in each release (2019, 21.09, 22.01, 23.01).
metadata_fields: warc headers; language id; quality warnings; categories (UT1 blocklist)
acquisition_method: Accept terms on HF (oscar-corpus/OSCAR-2301), then download te shards with HF token
license: CC0 1.0 (packaging); content subject to original copyright
verification_method: HF API (license tag, gated flag)
processing_needs: Included in CulturaX; avoid double counting.

organization: Google Research (released via AllenAI on HF)
description: Document-level audited multilingual Common Crawl corpus (2023) with 'clean' and 'noisy' splits per language.
acquisition_method: load_dataset('allenai/MADLAD-400', languages=['te'], split='clean')
verification_method: HF tree API file sizes
unresolved_issues: Clean vs noisy split sizes not separated (rate-limited during check).
processing_needs: Use 'clean' split; dedup vs other CC corpora.

description: Multilingual C4 corpus used to train mT5 (71 Common Crawl snapshots up to 2020), Telugu split 'te'.

copyright_notes: mC4 Telugu is known to contain substantial boilerplate and mis-identified text.
verification_method: HF API + datasets-server size (marked partial)
processing_needs: Prefer CulturaX (already cleans mC4).

description: Document-level monolingual corpus for 22 Indic languages (2024), crawled with document boundaries retained, intended for long-context pretraining.
acquisition_method: huggingface-cli download cfilt/IITB-IndicMonoDoc --repo-type dataset --include 'te/*'
copyright_notes: License covers compilation; crawled content copyright not cleared.
verification_method: HF API license + tree file sizes
processing_needs: Dedup vs Sangraha/IndicCorp v2.

description: NVIDIA Indic pretraining set (2025-26) with Telugu-script and romanised Telugu configs; per the card largely synthetic/specialised content (rephrased, translated, QA-style) for Indic LLM pretraining.
size_telugu: te-Telu-IN 11,969,113 rows / 86.4 GB; te-Latn-IN 2,286,686 rows / 22.0 GB
acquisition_method: load_dataset('nvidia/Nemotron-Pretraining-Indic-Specialized-v1', 'te-Telu-IN')
verification_method: HF API + datasets-server size
unresolved_issues: Exact license text ('other') and share of synthetic vs natural text need reading of the full card/license file.
processing_needs: Separate synthetic from natural text.

description: NVIDIA-filtered Common Crawl Indic subset with a Telugu config (gated).
acquisition_method: Accept terms on HF, then load config te-Telu-IN
verification_method: HF API (gated, config names)
unresolved_issues: Size and license text not visible without login.

collection_name: A Gold Standard Telugu Raw Text Corpus (Vol. I & Vol. II)
organization: Linguistic Data Consortium for Indian Languages, Central Institute of Indian Languages (Ministry of Education)
description: Curated, domain-balanced Telugu text from published books, magazines and newspapers (6 domains, 29 sub-categories), in XML with bibliographic headers. Vol. II released 2025.
genres: literature; mass media; science; social science; aesthetics; commerce
size_telugu: Vol. I: 3,010,993 words, 859 titles, 24.9M characters (released 2019-04-04); Vol. II: 3,013,530 words, 160 titles (catalogue 1511, released 2025-03-20)
metadata_fields: title; author; publisher; year; domain; sub-domain
acquisition_method: Register on data.ldcil.org, request dataset; free for bona fide academic/government users, priced licence for commercial users (price shown after login).
license: LDC-IL licence agreement (academic free / commercial paid)
copyright_notes: Commercial use requires a paid licence; redistribution of the corpus is not permitted under LDC-IL terms.
verification_method: Catalogue page contents via search index; portal is JavaScript-rendered and was not fully inspectable
unresolved_issues: Exact licence text and current commercial price require login.
processing_needs: Clean, balanced, copyright-cleared text — valuable as a high-quality, genre-balanced evaluation/pretraining slice.

description: OCR text of 767 public-domain books, documents and magazine issues on the history of the Telugu region (Telangana, Coastal Andhra, Rayalaseema), split into search passages; the PD part of the teluguhistory.org research library.
historical_period: Colonial and early modern publications (pre-1960s PD works)
size_telugu: 767 works; 227,618 scanned pages; 365,239 passages (963,695 rows in datasets-server across configs)
acquisition_method: load_dataset('opentelugu/telugu-history-public-domain')
license: CC0 1.0 (HF tag; sources stated to be public domain)
copyright_notes: PD status asserted by uploader; spot-check works with authors who died after 1965 (India: life + 60 years).
verification_method: Dataset card read; HF API license; datasets-server row count

description: Telugu 'Web-as-Corpus' crawl, line-level.

verification_method: HF API + datasets-server size

copyright_notes: Scraped newspaper text; publisher copyright applies.
verification_method: HF API; repo tree (loader script only)
unresolved_issues: Kaggle license field not checked (Kaggle requires login).

collection_name: Telugu corpora (news / web / Wikipedia, various years)
